content:
The v4.16.0-rc2 release of Lean is here!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language. Please read the release notes for details.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.16.0-rc2.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.16.0-rc2.

  • there is a v4.16.0-rc2 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

(Note that v4.16.0-rc1 had a problem preventing lake exe cache get working in projects downstream of Mathlib. I've verified this is now fixed, and so downstream projects wanting to bump their Mathlib dependency may (should!) do so again. Thanks for your patience on this one.)
